description: Read-only stdio MCP server for dated trust receipts on named entities before agent actions, backed by Lodestar Stamp's public discovery card and REST API.

notes: The public REST path and stdio MCP package do not require an API key.
Website, docs, llms.txt, discovery card, public REST endpoints, and npm package metadata were reachable during maintainer review.
The discovery card advertises the stdio MCP package lodestar-stamp-mcp.
